## Welcome to the Malaysia 15th Anniversary Championship 2024!
​
[![](https://i.imgur.com/oRN01S9m.jpg)](https://beacons.ai/malaysiacubechampionship)
​
Kindly read through all tabs on this page as they contain very useful information.


**Please note**
Competitors of all nationalities are welcome,

There will be **2 types of winner** in this competition:
**Open Category** - Top 3 winners of the competition regardless of nationality
**Malaysian Category** - Top 3 Malaysian winners of the competition

Participants representing Malaysia will have the opportunity to win special trophies, prizes, and the title of Malaysia Champion. The number of competitors in all final rounds may increase until there are at least 6 Malaysian competitors who advance


***Our schedule, cutoff & time limit is subject to change based on the number of registrants for each event; please pay close attention throughout the open registration period to see if our schedule has been adjusted.***
